currentContext.expansion: Expansion in FY 2025-26 was funded by the Company's maiden IPO on the BSE SME Platform (fresh issue of 19,20,000 equity shares allotted 02 February 2026), which listed at a premium of approximately 50%. The proceeds are being utilised towards automation of the existing manufacturing facility, acquisition of machinery for new manufacturing setups, working capital requirements and general corporate purposes. Following the IPO the Company initiated installation of high-speed, automated machinery at its single Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat facility, in line with the stated objects of the Prospectus; enhancements across the tablet, capsule and liquid oral sections are expected to improve production capacity, increase operational efficiency and support margin expansion. The facility has a built-up area of 10,763 sq. ft. and a FY26 installed capacity of 71.645 million units across six dosage forms, with a portfolio of 200+ formulations run under a CDMO and direct-sales model. Management also notes continuing investment in manufacturing infrastructure, automation and inventory-management systems to support scalability, and lists 'IPO-funded capacity expansion and working capital reinforcement enhancing scalability and market reach' among its SWOT strengths. Packaging of finished products is at present carried out manually, indicating a further area open to automation. No rupee capex quantum, no new site, and no dated commissioning milestone were disclosed in the routed material.
